description: Phase 0 rating rules — single source of truth for the rating math. Changing a rule means editing THIS file, never the code. Director answers 2026-08-19: (1) any set won by more than max_winner_games resolves to max_winner_games - resolved_loser_games (6-4) for the winner, regardless of how long a tiebreak lasted; (2) the 1x/2x/3x/4x values are section identifiers of the score, not multipliers.
